snippet.title: "Icebear 2026" trailer - deer hunting themed indie horror game
snippet.description:
"Something's hunting these deer... and it's not a wolf."

Icebear 2026 is a short PSX/PS1-style horror experience set in the remote forests of Zekeley County, Oregon, in January 2026.
An unknown natural disaster has caused the deer population to become extinct, leading to a surge in the price of their skins.
A contact from the city has pointed you to a restricted area on the map, located deep in the forests of the Northwest Coast. But the deeper you delve in your greedy pursuit of prey, the more strange things begin to happen. Perhaps you'll be the one to discover the cause...
